display.title: Episode 520: A Diamond from Heaven (Purim)
display.summary_short: Days before Purim, Uncle Yossi leads children in Tehillim for the Rebbe's recovery, then tells how Rashi's father gave up a priceless diamond rather than let it adorn an idol.
display.summary_long: Broadcast a few days before Purim 5752, shortly after the Rebbe fell ill. Uncle Yossi explains that children's voices in Torah and prayer, the 'voice of Yaakov', can overturn any bad decree, just as the 22,000 children Mordechai taught brought Haman's downfall. He asks every listener to join in a prayer for the Rebbe's complete recovery and leads chapter 20 of Tehillim word by word. A first-grade class from a Brooklyn yeshiva recites the Shema, and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time, 'A Diamond from Heaven': Rabbi Yitzchak of France, a great scholar and diamond dealer, buys a magnificent stone, but the governor wants it for an idol. Unable to refuse openly, he prays with Tehillim, then takes the stone to the governor's seaside porch to show it in the sunlight and lets it slip into the sea. A heavenly voice promises him a son who will light up the world with Torah: Rashi. The show ends with Purim fun: Uncle Yossi brings out a gragger, and a guest singer leads Purim songs with everyone sounding their graggers at Haman's name.
display.lesson: Children's Torah and prayers reach the heavens; and giving up something precious for Hashem's honor brings a far greater reward.

date.note: 'Be in shul tomorrow night to listen to the Megillah': Purim 5752 began Wednesday night 18 March 1992; also the prayer for the Rebbe's recovery after 27 Adar I (2 March 1992).
